user.title: Connect to the engine
user.description: Enter the address and the API key of the Pet Recognition Engine. With the engine app on Home Assistant OS, the engine is usually discovered instead.

data_description.url: The engine's address, such as http://docker-host:8765.
data_description.api_key: The key set in the engine's API key option, or its API_KEY variable.

hassio_confirm.title: Engine found
hassio_confirm.description: Connect to the Pet Recognition Engine of the {app} app?

reconfigure.title: Change the engine
reconfigure.description: Enter the engine's new address. Leave the API key empty to keep the current one.

data_description.url: The engine's address, such as http://docker-host:8765.
data_description.api_key: A new key, only if the engine's key changed.

reauth_confirm.title: New API key
reauth_confirm.description: The engine at {url} refused its API key. Enter the engine's current key.

data_description.api_key: The key set in the engine's API key option, or its API_KEY variable.

error.cannot_connect: The engine cannot be reached at this address.
error.invalid_auth: The engine refused this API key.
error.invalid_url: Enter an http or https address, such as http://docker-host:8765.
error.key_too_short: The API key has at least 16 characters.
error.not_an_engine: This address does not answer as a Pet Recognition Engine of a supported version.

abort.already_configured: The engine is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: The engine is already being set up.
abort.invalid_discovery_info: The engine app announced an address or key that cannot be used.

cannot_connect.message: Cannot reach the Pet Recognition Engine: {error}

invalid_auth.message: The Pet Recognition Engine refused its API key.

not_an_engine.message: The address does not answer as a Pet Recognition Engine of a supported version: {error}

engine_unreachable.title: The Pet Recognition Engine does not answer
engine_unreachable.description: The engine at {url} has not answered as a Pet Recognition Engine for a quarter of an hour, so no picture can be recognized. Check that the engine app or container runs, and that this is its address. If the engine moved, use **Reconfigure** on the integration.

engine_incompatible.title: Update the Pet Recognition integration
engine_incompatible.description: The engine at {url} no longer serves version {api} of the API, which this integration speaks. Update the integration to the release of the engine.

engine_version_newer.title: The Pet Recognition Engine is newer than the integration
engine_version_newer.description: The engine is release {engine} and the integration release {integration}. They still work together, but update the integration so that both are of the same release.

engine_version_older.title: The Pet Recognition Engine is older than the integration
engine_version_older.description: The engine is release {engine} and the integration release {integration}. They still work together, but update the engine app or container so that both are of the same release.
